title: Edmund and the Kitchen
author: Ulyana Quintana
blurb: Emrys Underhill, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
